text:
Maya (Finance): Quick procurement bulletin: temporary tweaks to speed up cloud incident spend while we finish the midyear budget refresh. Short version below.

Ben (Infra): Short version pls :eyes: we have an urgent GPU rental request.

Maya (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Temporary single-invoice/card approval limit = $4,000 through Aug 31. 2) New fast-path cloud exception for outages/quotas (use the form). 3) Contractor/integrator PO threshold now $1,500. 4) All client-facing meal charges require itemized receipt + brief purpose.

Jordan (ProdOps): Is the $4k effective today? We submitted a rack rental yesterday.

Maya (Finance): Yes effective today. If you submitted already, add comment "proc-fast-path" in the invoice portal and Purchasing will prioritize.

Rajat (Purchasing): Fast-path flow (one-liner): fill https://intranet/redwood/finance/cloud-exception, include project, est. spend, incident ticket link, tag @Priya. Purchasing aims to triage within 3 business hours; Finance signs off for <= $4k. >$4k goes to director review.

approvals-bot: Exception request #4091 created (ben.infra). Attached: rental-quote.pdf. ETA review: ~2h.

Priya (Finance Partner): Reminder: submit a one-paragraph justification and vendor quote. Missing quote = delayed review. Also itemize receipts for meals even on card.

Ben (Infra): Got it, uploaded quote and ticket link. Thanks.

Maya (Finance): We'll post a 1-page checklist to #docs and hold a 15-min office hour Tuesday 11:00am PT for any questions. Ping me or @Rajat for anything blocking customer-facing systems.
